headline: Bitcoin is holding near $73,000–$74,000 after hot US inflation data made a December Fed rate hike the market's base case; MSCI says on Wednesday evening ET whether it will drop Strategy from its indexes.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko and alternative.me at about 7:00pm ET Tue 10 Nov (07:00 Bangkok Wed 11 Nov). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 32, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 the day before

stories.title: Hot inflation pushes bitcoin to its lowest since August and makes a December rate hike the base case
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose faster than forecast in October. Bitcoin fell below $73,000 for the first time since August, bond yields jumped, and traders no longer price any chance that the Fed holds rates on 9 December. Higher rates tend to weigh on assets like crypto that pay no interest.
points: Prices rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin touched $72,787 on Bitstamp, per Bitcoin.com News; The Block had it at $73,363, down 1.6%, at 2:38pm ET.
CoinDesk cited CME FedWatch at 85% for a quarter-point hike and 15% for a half-point; Yahoo Finance put the chance of a quarter-point hike at 84%.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 15 basis points to 5.015%, per CoinDesk.
US stocks also fell: the S&P 500 closed down 0.38% and the Nasdaq down 0.74%, per Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Big holders keep selling: bitcoin funds lose money and companies trim their coins
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Monday, and public companies, mostly bitcoin miners, have sold billions of dollars of bitcoin this year. These were bitcoin's biggest buyers in 2024 and 2025. Tuesday's fund flows are not published yet.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $201.08M net, including $213.23M from BlackRock's IBIT, per SoSoValue via Analytics Insight.
IBIT has had seven straight sessions of redemptions, and about $1.5B has left the funds since 2 Nov, per CoinDesk.
14 public companies have sold 108,247 BTC, about $8.08B, so far in 2026, per Lookonchain via CoinDesk.
MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1B over the past six weeks and plans to sell more, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk Daybook: ETF outflows mount, MARA sells

stories.title: MSCI decides Wednesday whether to drop Strategy, as bitcoin trades below Strategy's average cost
stories.summary: On Wednesday evening ET, MSCI announces its November index changes, which could remove companies whose main business is holding crypto, such as Strategy. Funds that copy the index would then need to sell the stock. Bitcoin is now below the average price Strategy paid for its coins.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov (about 5pm ET, 05:00 Thursday Bangkok); changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
Possible deletions named: Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi, per Tech Times.
Strategy holds 850,364 BTC bought for about $64.16B, an average of $75,456 per coin, per 24/7 Wall St citing its 9 Nov filing.

briefs.title: NYSE picks Avalanche for tokenized trading
briefs.summary: NYSE chose Avalanche to settle a planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform; AVAX rose about 5% in 24 hours, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Big banks fund a joint dollar stablecoin
briefs.summary: Goldman, Citi and other banks committed about $270M to a dollar stablecoin aiming to launch in the first half of 2027, per Bloomberg via Decrypt.

briefs.title: Crypto stocks fall with bitcoin
briefs.summary: Coinbase fell 4% to $130.49, Robinhood 3% to $80.67 and Circle 5% to $64.29 after the inflation data, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Solana and Aave hit harder
briefs.summary: Solana fell 4.1% to $82.95 and is down 25.3% over 30 days; Aave fell 6.1% to $123.75, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Trump Media books a bitcoin-driven profit
briefs.summary: Trump Media reported a Q3 profit of $409.7M, almost all from non-cash gains on bitcoin and shares, on revenue of $3.0M, per Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Massachusetts town bans crypto ATMs
briefs.summary: Framingham's council voted unanimously to ban crypto ATMs, citing $397,000 in local scam losses since 2023, per Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Senators press White House on prediction-market bets
briefs.summary: Sens. Warren and Merkley asked what the White House is doing after a former Trump teleprompter operator's bets, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Securitize shares jump
briefs.summary: Securitize rose 41% to $9.86 after Q3 results, a Citi upgrade and a $50M buyback, per CoinDesk.
